in_arabic.name: تميرة

in_urdu.name: تمیرا
in_urdu.long_meaning: تمیرا نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت آنکھوں والی لڑکی، یہ نام حسن و جمال کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: तमीरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: तमीरा नाम का अर्थ है सुंदर आंखों वाली सुंदर लड़की, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में सुंदरता और शालीनता का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: تميره
in_pashto.long_meaning: تميره نوم د پښتو ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د ښکلو سترګو نجلۍ ده، دا نوم د افغان کلتور کې د ښکلا او جمال نښه ده

in_english.name: Tameera

data.cultural_impact: The name Tameera holds a significant cultural impact within the Islamic community as it represents the noble pursuit of knowledge and exploration. In Islamic tradition, knowledge is seen as a great treasure, a means of self-improvement, and a way to connect with God. The name Tameera could be a reminder for individuals to seek out knowledge, travel to new places, meet new people, and engage with various experiences, as these actions can broaden one's horizons and expand their understanding of the world around them.
data.spiritual_significance: Moreover, within the spiritual realm, the name Tameera holds deep significance for Muslim believers. The continuous pursuit of knowledge and wisdom is seen as a means to grow closer to God. Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was known to have said, "Seek knowledge, even if it is in China" (Malik ibn Anas). Thus, the name Tameera can be seen as a representation of this divine command, with the individual actively seeking knowledge and wisdom, not just for their own personal growth, but for the greater good of their community and the world at large. By embodying the spirit of a Tameera, an individual is living out their faith, seeking knowledge and sharing it with others in the spirit of love andcompassion - making the world a better place for all.
